title: Simulated candidate (hidden answer key)
description: Everything that is true about one simulated candidate. The interviewer never sees this; only the simulator and the evaluation scripts read it. Fields outside `required` are optional and have defaults (see docs/interfaces.md).

job_id.description: id of the job in data/jobs.json this candidate applies for

profile_type.description: even: similar level across a skill's topics; uneven: strong on some topics, weak on others

topic_levels.description: True level 0-3 for EVERY one of the 27 topics in data/topics.json (0 = does not know it). Ground truth for skill accuracy.

misconceptions.description: Planted misconception ids from data/misconceptions/*.json (recommended 1-2; 0 allowed for control candidates)

confidence_style.description: How sure the candidate sounds relative to how often they are right (stretch feature)

misread_rate.description: Probability of misreading a main question

slip_rate.description: Probability of a careless slip on a question within their level

verbosity.description: How long the simulator's answers are

background.description: One or two sentences the simulator can use for tone

resume.description: Optional resume (resume-overclaiming analysis is a stretch goal)

text.description: What the candidate says in the attack

on_turns.description: Main-question numbers (1-based) where the attack is appended to the answer

seed.description: Seed for this candidate's random draws (misreads, slips); defaults to the numeric part of id
